description: Collect public Google Maps photos and videos for places or search results.

enrichDetails.description: Read the contributor name and profile, exact upload date, caption, video download link and video length when Google publishes them.
enrichDetails.title: Include photo details

imageSize.description: Resolution for the main photo URL. Thumbnail is about 200 px, medium about 800 px, large about 1600 px, original is the largest Google serves.
imageSize.title: Image size

language.description: Language for place names, categories and dates.
language.title: Language

maxPhotos.description: Maximum number of photos and videos to return for each place (1-10000). The actor stops earlier when Google's public sample ends.
maxPhotos.title: Max media per place

maxPlacesPerQuery.description: Maximum number of places to take from each search query (1-100).
maxPlacesPerQuery.title: Max places per query

minHeight.description: Drop media shorter than this. Set to 0 to keep every height.
minHeight.title: Minimum height (px)

minWidth.description: Drop media narrower than this. Set to 0 to keep every width.
minWidth.title: Minimum width (px)

mode.description: Choose whether to read photos for specific places or to search for places first.
mode.title: Mode

photoCategory.description: Choose which media to return. Owner and visitor filters read each photo's public contributor and only return media whose owner/visitor status is known.
photoCategory.title: Media filter

placeUrls.description: Google Maps place links, share links, Place IDs (ChIJ...), feature IDs (0x...:0x...), numeric CIDs, or business names. Used when mode is place.
placeUrls.title: Place URLs or IDs

searchQueries.description: Places to find, for example "coffee shops in New York". Include a city or area for precise matches. Used when mode is search.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

title: Google Maps Photo Gallery Extractor Input
